description: VMware Tools 13.1.0 (build 25218885) for Windows. Attached as the second ISO by the Packer build and installed in the guest by enable-winrm.ps1 during specialize. It arrived as vmtools/windows.iso inside the Broadcom download recorded in origin and was renamed when published to the datastore; that member hashes to sha256 (verified 2026-09-30), so the datastore copy is the vendor ISO. Hash and size measured from the datastore copy on 2026-09-23.
